image_description: A bathroom scene featuring a toilet with the lid up. A roll of patterned toilet paper sits on the toilet seat/tank area. Significant amounts of shredded or unrolled toilet paper hang from the wall and ceiling area above the toilet, creating a chaotic, messy appearance. The toilet paper has a colorful geometric pattern rather than being plain white.

artifact_observations.location: Upper right quadrant, hanging paper strips
artifact_observations.reasoning: The long strips of paper hanging from the top edge lack clear physical attachment points. They appear to float or merge into the wall/ceiling texture without a logical source (e.g., a dispenser or hook), suggesting AI generation logic failure regarding object support.
The texture of the hanging paper becomes indistinct and 'mushy' towards the top, losing the defined geometric pattern seen on the roll. The edges bleed slightly into the background wall.
The elliptical curvature of the toilet seat and bowl rim shows slight inconsistency in thickness and perspective alignment, appearing slightly warped.
